rationale: Adds a new persisted event table that stores user-typed refine instruction text readable across all teams through a new super-admin API, instruments the generation, refine and publish choke points, and adds a rendered-headline column to Draft with a badge that rewrites stored HTML, so it touches a trust boundary and persisted data shape.

signals.blast_radius: About 25 to 35 files: a new migration and event table, the track wrapper, emission in about 7 server choke points (generateDraft, draftActions, commitDraftRevision, publishDraft, jobRunner, generationRunner, MCP/ACP tools), token reads in anthropicCall and the CLI caller, a new POST /api/events, /admin/insights page and API, a third worker loop, and a draft-page badge that rewrites HTML.
signals.unresolved: Open questions change the build: the wizard abandonment definition, whether claude -p reports usage in the app's output mode (decides whether CLI events carry tokens), the exact-once headline match rule on freeform Path B HTML, attribution of MCP/ACP/scheduler events with no acting user, and whether deleted teams and users cascade or are anonymised.
signals.irreversibility: The migration adds a table and a nullable column that are cheap to revert, but stored refine text is kept 180 days and cannot be recalled once written, and the stale-badge replace commits revisions that alter draft HTML.
